class.name: OpenDustAgentServer
class.brief_description: The agent bridge: JSON-RPC 2.0 over a loopback WebSocket.
class.description: Lets agents (Claude Code through [code]tools/opendust-mcp[/code], or any MCP/WebSocket client) drive the editor or a running game through the tools in [OpenDustToolRegistry]. One server runs per process: the editor starts one in [constant MODE_EDITOR]; a running game starts one in [constant MODE_RUNTIME] when [code]opendust/agent/runtime_autostart[/code] is on. On start the server writes [code]<project>/.opendust/bridge-<mode>.json[/code] (port, token, pid) and [code]mcp-<mode>.json[/code] (a Claude Code MCP config pointing at the bridge script). Clients must send [code]session.hello[/code] with the token before calling any tool. Project settings: [code]opendust/agent/port[/code] (0 = default 6120/6121, next 16 tried if busy), [code]opendust/agent/policy[/code] ([code]open[/code], [code]no_mutations[/code], [code]allowlist[/code]; runtime defaults to [code]no_mutations[/code]), [code]opendust/agent/allowed_tools[/code], [code]opendust/agent/runtime_autostart[/code], [code]opendust/agent/mcp_bridge_script[/code]. Print and error output is captured and forwarded as [code]event.log[/code] notifications and via the [code]editor.log_tail[/code] tool.

method.name: broadcast
method.description: Sends a JSON-RPC notification to every authenticated session.

method.name: get_sessions
method.description: Authenticated sessions as [code]{session_id, agent_name, agent_id, soul_ref, client, connected_at_ms, last_tool, tool_calls}[/code].

method.name: send_to
method.description: Sends a notification to one session.

method.name: stop
method.description: Closes every session, stops listening and removes the discovery file.
